== Biography ==
'''Jane Glasgow''' was named in a pre-1858 probate-index entry for '''Larne, County Antrim''', in '''1844'''.<ref>Public Record Office of Northern Ireland, ''Names, Pre-1858 Wills and Admons'', “Jane Glasgow, Larne, County Antrim, 1844,” [https://apps.proni.gov.uk/ProniNames_IE/SearchPage.aspx public search page], catalogue source reference f0ceb65f7b5573e6, accessed 19 August 2026. Item-detail URLs are session-bound.</ref>

Her birth is shown only as before 1826, an uncertain boundary estimate consistent with her being an adult by 1844. The index does not establish her birth place, exact death date or place, marital status, or any relatives. Larne is therefore recorded only as her documented probate residence.

Further index entries name Jane Glasgow of Larne in 1845 and in a Belfast probate entry in 1846.<ref>Public Record Office of Northern Ireland, ''Names, Pre-1858 Wills and Admons'', “Jane Glasgow, Larne, County Antrim, 1845,” [https://apps.proni.gov.uk/ProniNames_IE/SearchPage.aspx public search page], catalogue source reference 24cc43b15de3c6c5, accessed 19 August 2026. Item-detail URLs are session-bound.</ref><ref>Public Record Office of Northern Ireland, ''Names, Pre-1858 Wills and Admons'', “Jane Glasgow, Belfast probate; residence Larne, 1846,” [https://apps.proni.gov.uk/ProniNames_IE/SearchPage.aspx public search page], catalogue source reference 8eb33cd32019350b, accessed 19 August 2026. Item-detail URLs are session-bound.</ref> These may be later actions concerning the 1844 entry, but the surviving index information does not prove that all three entries concern the same woman.

== Research Notes ==
No parent, spouse, child, or connection to another Larne Glasgow household is proved by these index entries.

=== Current research ===

Glasgow-4013 represents Jane Glasgow of Larne in the 1844 probate index and is the best match for the Jane Glasgow whose death was registered in Larne district on 4 September 1873, aged 50. The name and locality agree, and the death-index age implies birth about 1823, compatible with the profile's uncertain "before 1826" birth bound. That earlier Larne reference documents probate residence, not a proved birthplace; the death registration district likewise does not establish her exact death place. The 1845 and 1846 Larne entries may be later actions for the same estate but do not independently prove identity. Jane Glasgow-3929 and other candidates have different documented family contexts.

This assessment draws on the cited records and public source material.<ref name="ProjectSource1">[https://apps.proni.gov.uk/ProniNames_IE/SearchPage.aspx PRONI Names, Pre-1858 Wills and Admons search].</ref><ref name="ProjectSource2">[https://geni.nidirect.gov.uk/search/death GRONI death search].</ref><ref name="ProjectSource3">[https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3Q9M-CS54-77Q4-H indenture of 25 March 1874].</ref>

A possible identification concerns Jane Glasgow. An 1874 indenture traces James Glasgow’s 2 October 1779 Newtown of Larne lease to a 25 February 1832 renewal to Anne and Jane Glasgow.<ref>Inspected historical source; [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3Q9M-CS54-77Q4-H record].</ref> Original recital inspected. It establishes title succession, not stated descent; James and both women’s identities remain unresolved. The identification remains uncertain.
